title: God is still with you in grief
description: Comfort for seasons of loss—when faith feels quiet but God has not stepped away.
summary: Grief is not a failure of faith. Jesus wept, and He walks with you through sorrow at your pace.
author: Pastor Samuel

blocks.text: Loss can make church feel loud when your heart feels hollow. You are not alone, and you are not behind spiritually because sorrow takes time.
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
